parameters.query:
SELECT r.*, $2::text AS message_id
FROM inbox.receive($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb) r;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.to, $json.messageId, $json.fromEmail, $json.fromName, $json.subject, $json.text, JSON.stringify($json.attachments.map(a => ({ kind: a.kind, name: a.name, mime: a.mime, size: a.size, key: a.key })))] }}
